# 11. No Griefing, Bug Abuse or Exploits
- Do not cause station destruction unless you have a justifiable roleplay or objective-based reason to do so. - Do not spam audio effects to specifically cause annoyance, such as attempting to enter a door excessively, spamming audio emotes, or deliberately causing other loud noises for the purpose of simply being loud and/or annoying. - Do not deliberately chat spam or flood comms. - Do not abuse bugs, exploits, or obviously unintended effects to gain an advantage during gameplay. Bugs can be reported in the Blimpuf Discord. - Using a silicon to do any of the above will be treated the same as doing it yourself. - Do not go AFK in order to deliberately farm hours for playtime requirements. If you are not participating in the round, your character should go to cryosleep if possible, and you should leave the game. Non-participation hours will be rolled back, if noticed. - Do not use cryosleep, ghosting, suicide, or NewLife to attempt to receive antagonist roles (aka “antag rolling”).
## Allowed - Destroying the station as a Nuclear Operative. - Blowing up the salvage shuttle because one of your kill targets is on it. - Giving a borg the order “go annoy the Chief Engineer” because you got in a fight earlier.
## Not Allowed - Loosing the tesla because you have an objective to kill the Janitor and CMO. - Blowing up the chem lab during your unrelated objective to kidnap the QM’s pet raccoon. - Telling all borgs to state their laws on common to flood the chatbox. - Using a physics exploit to propel yourself impossibly fast in a direction. - Giving a borg the order to dismantle all walls on the station because you think it would be hilarious. - Repeatedly and excessively attempting to uncuff yourself in order to force your captor to spam click.
